JYP Executives Land on 2026 Billboard Power 100
===============================================

Stray Kids' Record-Breaking Tour Boosts JYP's Global Influence in 2026 Billboard Power 100

By OSEN

Published 2026.01.30. 08:16

0

![Image 2](https://www.chosun.com/resizer/v2/MJRTIYRSMQ3DSMLGMEZDKNDDGE.jpg?auth=590d2f061d881d9a71039f37d6bbec59b55911adcf2ddc703f7fd9821d95cd2c&width=530&height=681&smart=true)

[OSEN=Jee Min-kyung Reporter] Park Jin-young, founder of JYP Entertainment (hereinafter JYP) and Chief Creative Officer (CCO), Jung Wook, CEO (Chief Executive Officer), and Shin Hyun-guk, CEO of JYP America and Chief Strategy Officer (CSO), have been selected for the '2026 Billboard Power 100.'

Billboard announced the '2026 Billboard Power 100' on its official website on the 28th, local time. Billboard annually selects and publishes influential figures in the global music industry across various sectors. Park Jin-young, founder and CCO of JYP, Jung Wook, CEO, and Shin Hyun-guk, CEO of JYP America and CSO, ranked 12th in the multi-sector category.

Billboard first noted, "JYP achieved record-breaking sales in the second quarter of 2025, driven by the global popularity of K-pop." It specifically highlighted the 'largest-scale' world tour 'Stray Kids World Tour ' by the 'global top artist' Stray Kids, stating, "While the company performed well in album sales and streaming, the highlight of the quarter was Stray Kids' tour. Concert and MD sales revenue surged by 342% and 356%, respectively."

It added, "Stray Kids attracted approximately 491,000 attendees through 13 performances in North America, generating $76.2 million in revenue. This marks the highest-selling and highest-grossing K-pop tour in North America according to Billboard Boxscore," spotlighting Shin Hyun-guk, CEO of JYP America, for his significant success in leading the tour.

Finally, Billboard evaluated, "The competitiveness of K-pop agencies depends on their ability to nurture artists, and JYP has successfully developed MISAMO, ITZY, NMIXX, KickFlip, and others."

Meanwhile, the 'Billboard Power 100' recognizes leaders exerting strong influence across sectors such as labels, publishing, live events, multi-sectors, and management. This year’s list includes Lucian Grainge, chairman of Universal Music Group, Monte Lipman and Avery Lipman, founders of Republic Collective, and Michael Rapino, CEO of Live Nation. /mk3244@osen.co.kr

[Photo] JYP Entertainment

# JYP Entertainment Tops Time Magazine's World's Best Companies in Sustainable Growth List

Written: 2025-11-14 17:10:10 / Updated: 2025-11-14 17:55:06

[Share](javascript:;)

[Print](#none)

Photo : JYP Entertainment

K-pop powerhouse JYP Entertainment topped Time Magazine's World's Best Companies in Sustainable Growth 2026 list.  
   
 On to the annual ranking of the world's top 500 companies announced by TIME and German market analytics firm Statista, JYP Entertainment scored the highest 97-point-59 out of 100 points.  
   
 The K-pop management agency ranked the highest among South Korean businesses for the second year in a row.  
   
 The annual list selects companies that demonstrate outstanding performance in sustainable development while maintaining strong financial health, with a focus on their revenue growth, economic stability and environmental impact.  
   
 Statista said the South Korean firm is one of a few companies that have demonstrated excellence in both financial and environmental performance.  
   
 In last year's sustainability report, JYP Entertainment said it monitors energy use, efficiency and waste to foster a sustainable concert culture and that it uses environmentally friendly materials and packaging for its merchandise.

# JYP, good influence..Invite vulnerable children and youth to the world tour

Published:

Lee Seunghun

\*This content was translated by AI.

Girl group ITZY (ITZY) invited vulnerable children and adolescents to the 2026 World Tour Seoul performance to support the healthy future and dreams.

ITZY opened its third world tour, ITZY 3RD WORLD TOUR  (tunnel vision), at Jamsil Indoor Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul from February 13 to 15. The welcome performance, which will take place in about a year and a half since the second world tour "BORN TO BE" (Born to Be) in August 2024, invited vulnerable children, adolescents, and families to fill the warmth.

Through JYP EDM partner organizations such as Samsung Medical Center, National Cancer Center, Seoul Asan Medical Center, and Yonsei Medical Center, children and families of vulnerable children and adolescents were invited to support their treatment journey and a brighter future. In particular, children and families who met ITZY members as mentors at the ITZY Dream Day, part of the World Vision Dream Support Project "Dreaming Children" in 2022, also watched the performance and built unforgettable memories. ITZY encouraged children who worked hard to develop their dreams even in difficult environments, while providing opportunities for cultural experiences and spreading good influence.

The five ITZY members continue to share in various forms at home and abroad. By implementing personal donations, he gave a warm hand to those in need, including support for forest fire damage in Gyeongsangnam-do, death and industrial and commercial firefighters, support for treatment expenses for vulnerable people in Korea, and emergency relief for the Syrian earthquake in Turkiye. In addition, he was in charge of JYP Entertainment's social contribution activity settlement event "EDM DAY" and participated in "JYP 4 EARTH," a social content that conveys a positive view for a sustainable society, further shining the value of sharing.

ITZY, which began its new world tour in 2026 by sharing the love it received from world wide fans, will perform around the world and expand its 'K-pop performance queen' presence.

# Founder of K-pop powerhouse JYP appointed to ministerial-level post on pop culture

[Sign up now:](/newsletter-signup?ref=inline-article#nl_asian_insider ) Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments

Mr Park Jin-young will co-chair the presidential Commission on Pop-Culture Exchange.

PHOTO: SCREENGRAB FROM ASIANSOUL\_JYP/INSTAGRAM

Published Sep 10, 2025, 09:50 AM

Updated Sep 10, 2025, 10:01 AM

SEOUL – MrPark Jin-young, founder and chief producer of K-pop powerhouse JYP Entertainment, has been tapped for a ministerial-level position on a new presidential committee launched to promote K-pop culture overseas, according to the presidential office on Sept 9.

Mr Park, a singer-songwriter-turned-executive, will co-chair the presidential Commission on Pop-Culture Exchange, along with Culture Minister Chae Hwi-young.

The new presidential committee will work to promote South Korean culture abroad while expanding exposure to foreign pop culture in SouthKorea, presidential chief of staff Kang Hoon-sik said in a briefing.

Mr Kang also described the 53-year-old Mr Park as one of the most prominent figures in the industry, having spearheaded bringing the K-pop industry into foreign markets.

“Mr Park has blazed the trail in exporting K-pop content to the United States, and now he has become a symbolic figure in the globalisation of K-pop industry,” Mr Kang said.

In a social media post on Sept 9, Mr Park pledged to push for practical government support for the K-pop industry and to expand opportunities for fellow artists.

Mr Park was one of the ministerial-level figures nominated by President Lee Jae Myung, along with former minister of governmentlegislation Lee Seog-yeon, tapped as the new leader of the Presidential Committee of National Cohesion, and former lawmaker and architect Kim Jin-ai, who is to lead the Presidential Commission on Architecture Policy.

Mr Lee also named attorney We Chul-whan as the chief of the National Election Commission.

Regarding the vice-ministerial level, Mr Lee named former three-time liberal lawmaker Kim Kyung-hyup as the chief of the Overseas Korean Agency and career civil servants Jung Goo-chang and Cho Sung-joo as vice-minister of gender equality and family and senior presidential secretary for personnel affairs, respectively, among others. We are living through a historic transformation. For decades, the global economic narrative was dominated by industrial output, the “Made in Asia” era of hardware and manufacturing. But in 2026, the Korean Renaissance has evolved into something far more powerful: Cultural Sovereignty. The rise of Stray Kids and their <dominATE> era is the ultimate case study in this new world order.Unlike many groups where a company chooses the “concept” and hands them a song, Stray Kids actually hand-picked their own members and built their own sound.

They coined the term “Mala-taste” to describe their experimental and bold sound. The Economic Halo Effect: SKZ influence drives a massive global demand that transcends the stage. From luxury fashion to tech and lifestyle, they have turned “Art” into a primary economic engine that fuels a multi-billion dollar ecosystem. Past decades, cultural “cool” was dictated by a few centralized hubs. In 2026, Stray Kids and STAYs have built their own independent “republic.” By owning their production and their narrative, they’ve dismantled the old barriers to prove that authenticity is the highest-valued currency.
